classification.difficultyReason: Classify four quadrilaterals by reading tick and arrow marks against the definitions. There is no calculation, but the student must separate parallelogram, rhombus and kite markings.

content.prompt: Identify the special quadrilateral as a parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, or kite.

answer.worked: Kite: the ticks show two pairs of adjacent equal sides.
Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides are marked parallel.
Rhombus: all four sides have the same equality tick.
Trapezium: it has one pair of parallel sides.
